line.name: E.P. Carrillo 5 Year Anniversary
line.background_text: Released August 15, 2014 to commemorate the fifth anniversary of E.P. Carrillo, the company Ernesto Perez-Carrillo founded in 2009 after leaving General Cigar. A limited, one-time fall release produced in only 3,000 ten-count boxes, made at Tabacalera La Alianza in the Dominican Republic.

vitolas.summary_review: A very strong, coffee- and pepper-forward cigar considered one of the boldest releases in the E.P. Carrillo catalog; halfwheel scored it 85, Cigar Coop scored it 92.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: Strongest E.P. Carrillo cigar the reviewer could recall; robust coffee, earth, wood, pepper.
Pepper blast opening into coffee, cream, oak and banana; medium-to-full moving to full.

research_notes: Only one vitola (6.5x54) found. Distinct from the later 'E.P. Carrillo 15 Year Anniversary' line. Some retailers list it as '5th Year Anniversary' - same product.

research_sources.supports: blend, size, release date, box count, score, tasting notes
